item.text: The first day produced 39 link clicks from $114.09 in spend. The two posts have similar costs per click so far, so I’m keeping both running while more data comes in. X still provides no install signal to tell us which post drives more installs.

After two days, spend is $246.99 with 87 link clicks. Costs per click remain close: $2.79 for the school-benefits post and $2.89 for the deadline post. I’ve raised daily budgets slightly to keep delivery on pace; the combined lifetime cap remains $650.
Three days in, the campaign has spent $383.99 and delivered 133 link clicks. Neither post has a clear cost advantage, so both remain active for the final two days.

The final day starts with $526.16 spent and 181 link clicks. There’s $123.84 left under the lifetime caps. Both posts are still delivering at similar costs, and the flight is set to end tonight at midnight Central.
